items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: my good friend Ron Delacasa is a disc jockey up there.

ctx.x: How’s the recording been for you as far as do they pay you a flat feel to do that?

Those people did. I never sold enough at ABC. Remember those were like major labels, ABC and Epic, my first two albums. And then the others were more or less down hill because they were little jazz labels, not counting the one that was a complete obscure thing, Lullabies, that was Realm Records or somebody. Then I did one for friends in Boston, recorded at Jordan Hall, my good friend Ron Delacasa is a disc jockey up there. That was another obscure one, and I don’t think that ever got outside of Boston much. And…
All you record label owners out there.
